parameters.name: Brand
parameters.description: The CA brand. Valid values: WoSign, CFCA, DigiCert, GeoTrust, GlobalSign, vTrus, and Alibaba.

parameters.name: CertificateStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:
- **issued**: Issued.
- **revoked**: Revoked.
- **willExpire**: About to expire.
- **expired**: Expired.

parameters.name: CertificateType
parameters.description: The type of the certificate. Valid values: DV, OV, and EV.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The instance type. Valid values:
- BUY: official certificate.
- TEST: test certificate.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for fuzzy search. Matches domain names, instance names, or corresponding resource IDs.

parameters.name: ShowSize
parameters.description: The number of instances to display per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**. Maximum value: **100**.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The instance status. Valid values:
- **inactive**: Pending use.
- **pending**: Under review. The latest certificate is being reviewed.
- **willExpire**: About to expire.
- **expired**: Expired.
- **refund**: Refunded.
- **normal**: Normal.
- **closed**: Closed and unavailable.
